name: NK Co., Ltd.
summary: NK Co., Ltd. provides high-pressure gas container products in Korea and internationally. The company offers various marine extinguishing systems; ballast water treatment systems; and storage vessels, ton tanks, CNF and IMDG tube kids, industrial gas tube kids, air pressure vessel for drillship and driving system, and mobile stations, as well as provides aluminum and steel helidecks, fuel LNG tanks, and jumbo cylinder retests. It also designs, manufactures, and constructs onshore and offshore plant facilities. In addition, the company offers tube trailers, ultra-low temperature storage containers; and gas-based and water-based extinguishing systems, gas supply systems, form extinguishing equipment, etc. NK Co., Ltd. was founded in 1980 and is based in Busan, South Korea.
